measures.label: Medi-Cal members who experienced homelessness, rate per 10,000 Medi-Cal members
measures.note: DHCS Behavioral Health Transformation 'Reduce Homelessness' measure, published in the Behavioral Health Public County Profile as 'Rate (per 10,000) of Medi-Cal members who experienced homelessness'. Sutter County value is the combined Sutter-Yuba behavioral health county value (DHCS does not publish Sutter alone). California value is the DHCS 'State' row.

measures.label: Medi-Cal members with significant behavioral health needs who experienced homelessness, rate per 10,000 Medi-Cal members with significant behavioral health needs
measures.note: DHCS Behavioral Health Transformation 'Reduce Homelessness' measure, published in the Behavioral Health Public County Profile as 'Rate (per 10,000) of Medi-Cal members with significant BH needs who experienced homelessness'. Sutter County value is the combined Sutter-Yuba behavioral health county value (DHCS does not publish Sutter alone). California value is the DHCS 'State' row.
